column_description: A SERIAL primary key uniquely identifying each transmission record.
A VARCHAR(70) foreign key referencing Equipment(EquipmentCode), linking the transmission data to a specific piece of equipment.
An INTEGER foreign key referencing EngineAndFluids(EngineRegistry), associating this transmission with a particular engine/fluids record.
A REAL value measuring the current transmission temperature in Celsius.
A DECIMAL(8,2) indicating transmission fluid pressure in kilopascals.
A SMALLINT representing the currently engaged gear (e.g., 3, -1, 1, 6, 0, 2, 5, 4).
A DOUBLE PRECISION value for the differential’s temperature in Celsius.
A FLOAT specifying the axle’s temperature in Celsius.
An INTEGER optionally referencing an OperationMaintenance(OpMaintRegistry) record for linking maintenance or operational data.
